title: AIPointer: Hold a key, ask a question, get an answer about whatever your cursor is pointing at

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Google's magic pointer is Chromebook only. AI pointer brings it to every OS. Wiggle your mouse or hit a hotkey and a glass morphism overlay appears right next to your cursor. It screenshots whatever you're pointing at and feeds it to a vision model. Type or speak your question in any of seven languages. Get your answer without switching tabs or copying anything. Bring your own key. Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini.
